All app commands run inside a **frappe-bench**, with the app installed at `apps/healthcare`.

**Install / setup**
```sh
bench get-app <repo-url>              # add app to bench
bench --site <site> install-app healthcare
bench --site <site> migrate            # runs patches.txt + after_migrate
```

**Tests** (the CI command)
```sh
bench --site test_site run-parallel-tests --app healthcare --total-builds 1 --build-number 1
# single doctype/module during development:
bench --site test_site run-tests --app healthcare --doctype "Patient Appointment"
```
The test site needs ERPNext and payments installed (see `.github/helper/install.sh`). `before_tests` (`healthcare.healthcare.utils.before_tests`) seeds fixtures.

**Lint / format** (run from `apps/healthcare`)
```sh
pip install pre-commit && pre-commit install
npm install
pre-commit run --all-files   # ruff --fix, ruff-format, eslint, prettier, pip-audit, detect-secrets, yaml/json/toml checks
# Frappe semgrep rules (also run in CI):
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/frappe/semgrep-rules.git .frappe-semgrep-rules
pip install semgrep
semgrep ci --config ./.frappe-semgrep-rules/rules --config r/python.lang.correctness
```
CI also runs `python -m compileall -f .` and greps for leftover merge-conflict markers.

**Patient portal (Vue)**
```sh
yarn install          # root postinstall also runs yarn install in patient_portal
yarn build            # root → cd patient_portal && yarn build (vite build --base=/assets/healthcare/patient_portal/)
cd patient_portal && yarn dev   # vite dev server with frappe proxy
```

**Translations**
```sh
bench generate-pot-file --app healthcare   # regenerates healthcare/locale/main.pot
```
